title: Drupaceous
summary: DRUPACEOUS, adjective 1. Producing drupes; as drupaceous trees. 2. Pertaining to drupes; or consisting of drupes; as drupaceous fruit; drupaceous follicles.

inlines.v: DRUPACEOUS, adjective 1. Producing drupes; as drupaceous trees. 2. Pertaining to drupes; or consisting of drupes; as drupaceous fruit; drupaceous follicles.
